title: Kent Beck — “Eric's mission to make companies safe for their missions”
summary: Beck, who created Extreme Programming and test-driven development, read an advance copy and drew a line between his own stated purpose and the book's. Eric published the line on LinkedIn.
blockquote: Reviewing Incorruptible got me thinking about the connection between my purpose (‘help geeks feel safe in the world’) and Eric’s mission to make companies safe for their missions.
blockquote_source: Kent Beck, quoted by Eric Ries on LinkedIn
